question.text: When comparing PMs with different benchmarks, a fair comparison uses:

answer.text: Risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe, Treynor, Information Ratio) and excess vs benchmark

explanation.text: The Logic: Risk-adjusted metrics + benchmark-relative returns enable apples-to-apples comparison. The Trap: Absolute/size/vintage alone are inadequate. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Report a standardized PM league table using Sharpe and IR side-by-side.
